review_type: Read-only source/dataflow review, not an antivirus scan
findings: No eval/Function/dynamic code injection, HTML parser sinks, encoded payload decoder or external endpoint found.
One fetch wrapper; every caller supplies a root-relative /api route. Job ids are URL-encoded. Voice id route values originate from server-owned built-in ids or custom-32hex UUIDs.
User text/files/names/job metadata render with textContent/value/newOption; no innerHTML/document.write use.
Selected user text files are locally decoded by TextDecoder and placed into textarea; selected voice files are posted only to /api/voices/upload after user click.
Audio/download job URLs are constructed locally; reference-player src comes from /api/voices/{id}/source generated in app.py line118.
Only localStorage value is selected voice identifier; no cookies/credential collection or general filesystem access.
No front-end defect identified that explains the Defender signature.
limits: Source review cannot determine whether Defender classification is a false positive.
No product code modified to vary detection signature.
Same-origin/CSP/Host-Origin guards could be separate hardening, but no evidence they caused this alert.
